summary: Learn practical storage control, moisture monitoring, and loss reduction methods. Build tools you can apply immediately.
lede: Post-harvest residue management is part of storage hygiene for professionals handling crops and produce, helping limit spoilage and protect quality. Training covers cleaning schedules and residue removal alongside moisture measurement, storage-condition monitoring, and pest-control routines, with practical work in inspection logs and corrective-action planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in crop handling, storage, quality control, or agricultural supply operations and need more structured methods for reducing loss.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of crop handling, warehouse or store operations, and basic agricultural supply chain processes. No coding is required for completion. A calculator, laptop, and familiarity with simple spreadsheets are helpful for the loss calculation and monitoring exercises. Participants should come prepared with a current storage challenge, inventory loss issue, or commodity handling process from their own work environment so they can apply the templates and diagnostic tools during class.
